name: Better LucX
description: Improvements for LucX-UI subscriptions and clients: any third-party link of any scheme can be given to a client, in the client form too (the panel refuses schemes it does not know), and every AmneziaWG node also gets the amneziawg://<config> link INCY imports, and CSQTT links are given in the plain form proxy clients read. CSQTT and OpenFlux links get their inbound's remark as the name on the subscription page. Switch it off and the panel does what it always did.
author: AllIsA1
